arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) AS data FROM bookings WHERE status!='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status!='confirmed') UNION ALL SELECT 'events',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT b.*, c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,e.event_id AS cancel_event,e.step AS cancel_step,h.flight_id AS held_flight FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending'
